items.situation: classmate asking to borrow lecture notes
items.speaker: Can I grab your notes? I'm completely lost.

options.A: Be my guest, they're in my bag.
options.B: I grabbed a coffee before class too.
options.C: The parking lot was full again.

items.explanation: 同学开口借笔记。正确答 A 用地道口语 "Be my guest"（你随便用）爽快应允，并顺带说明笔记在包里，是被请求方最自然的回应（idiomatic）。B 抓住 grab 换成 grabbed，讲自己课前买咖啡，只借关键词不回应请求（语义联想陷阱）。C 说停车场又满了，与借笔记毫无关系（离题）。D 回答"大概四十页"，答的是数量，而对方问的是能不能借（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking about a campus event or concert
items.speaker: How's the spring concert ticket line looking?

options.A: The concert hall seats two thousand people.
options.B: Actually, it's already wrapped around the building.
options.C: I've never learned to play an instrument.
options.D: Yes, I bought two of them.

items.explanation: 对方打听春季音乐会的排队情况。正确答 B 以话语标记 "Actually" 开头，不直接说"长"，而是用"队伍已经绕楼一圈"间接给出答案，口语中最自然（marker_led_indirect）。A 抓住 concert 转去讲音乐厅能坐两千人，说的是场馆而非队伍（语义联想陷阱）。C 说自己从没学过乐器，与排队情况无关（离题）。D 用"是的，我买了两张"回答，把 How 开头的问句当成是非问句来答（答非所问）。

items.situation: two classmates discussing a group project deadline
items.speaker: Where are we supposed to upload the project?

options.A: This project took way more time than expected.
options.B: She's been out sick since Tuesday.
options.C: Just drop it in the shared folder.

items.explanation: 小组成员问作业交到哪里。正确答 C 以话语标记 "Just" 开头，直接指路"扔进共享文件夹"，简短自然（marker_led_indirect）。A 抓住 project 感慨这次项目太费时间，只借关键词不回答地点（语义联想陷阱）。B 说她从周二起就病假，换了人也换了话题（离题）。D 回答"周五午夜之前"，答的是时间，而对方问的是地点（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking about campus shuttle or parking
items.speaker: Do I need a permit to park here?

options.A: Parking got much harder after the renovation.
options.B: My roommate borrowed the car this morning.
options.D: Take my spot behind the gym instead.

items.explanation: 对方问这里停车要不要许可证。正确答 D 不纠缠"要不要证"，而是直接解决背后的真实需求——把自己体育馆后面的车位让出来（context_shift，ETS 最典型的间接应答）。A 抓住 park 谈翻修后停车更难，只是评论现状、不解决问题（语义联想陷阱）。B 说室友早上把车开走了，与对方能否停车无关（离题）。C 回答"每十五分钟一班，到九点"，答的是班车频次，而对方问的是许可证（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking about gym or sports facility hours
items.speaker: Why's the gym closing so early tonight?

options.A: Didn't you see the meet is tonight?
options.B: The gym added new rowing machines.
options.C: I finished my paper an hour ago.
options.D: Yes, you can bring a guest.

items.explanation: 对方疑惑体育馆今晚为什么早关。正确答 A 用一个反问"你没看到今晚有比赛吗"点明原因并推进对话，是口语中极自然的应答（counter_question）。B 抓住 gym 说新添了划船机，只借关键词、不解释原因（语义联想陷阱）。C 说自己一小时前写完论文了，与体育馆无关（离题）。D 用"可以带一位客人"作答，把 Why 问句当成是非问句（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking about course enrollment or prerequisites
items.speaker: I still haven't gotten into the stats seminar.

options.A: Statistics has three sections this term.
options.B: Well, the waitlist usually clears by Friday.
options.C: My cousin is visiting over the weekend.
options.D: In room 204, next to the lab.

items.explanation: 对方抱怨还没选上统计研讨课。正确答 B 以 "Well" 起头，间接安抚并给出有用信息——候补名单一般周五就会放开（marker_led_indirect）。A 抓住 stats 说统计课本学期开了三个班，陈述事实却无视对方的焦虑（语义联想陷阱）。C 说表亲周末来访，完全另起话题（离题）。D 给出教室位置"204 房间，实验室旁边"，对方并没有问地点（答非所问）。

items.situation: coordinating airport pickup with a friend
items.speaker: I'm landing around eleven Saturday night.

options.A: Saturday flights are usually the most crowded.
options.B: The concert tickets sold out last week.
options.C: Consider it covered, I'll be there.
options.D: Yes, I've been to that airport.

items.explanation: 朋友告知自己周六深夜落地，言下之意是希望有人来接。正确答 C 用地道说法 "Consider it covered"（这事包在我身上）承接并承诺到场，正是听话人一方最自然的回应（idiomatic）。A 抓住 Saturday 谈周六航班最挤，只借关键词、不接话（语义联想陷阱）。B 说演唱会门票上周就卖光了，与接机无关（离题）。D 用"是的，我去过那个机场"作答，对方并没有提问，是把陈述句当成是非问句（答非所问）。

items.situation: student checking lost-and-found at front desk
items.speaker: When's the last time a wallet turned up?

options.A: That wallet design is really popular now.
options.B: The parking office moved to the annex.
options.C: Right by the elevator on two.
options.D: You're in luck, one came in today.

items.explanation: 学生到前台问最近有没有钱包被送来。正确答 D 用地道口语 "You're in luck"（你走运了）自然接话，并告知今天正好收到一个（idiomatic）。A 抓住 wallet 评论钱包款式流行，只借关键词、不回答（语义联想陷阱）。B 说停车办公室搬到附楼了，与失物招领无关（离题）。C 回答"就在二楼电梯旁"，答的是地点，而对方问的是时间（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking a professor about office hours or assignment
items.speaker: What's worth bringing to office hours?

options.A: Just bring the draft you're stuck on.
options.B: I brought my lunch to campus today.
options.C: She defended her dissertation two years ago.
options.D: Yes, you're allowed to record them.

items.explanation: 学生问去答疑时间该带什么。正确答 A 以 "Just" 起头，把范围缩到一件事——带上写不下去的那份草稿，简洁而实用（marker_led_indirect）。B 把 bring 换成 brought，说自己今天带了午饭来学校，只借词形不回应问题（语义联想陷阱）。C 说她两年前答辩完博士论文，换了人也换了话题（离题）。D 用"是的，可以录音"作答，把 What 问句当成是非问句（答非所问）。

items.situation: student asking about dorm maintenance issue
items.speaker: Has anyone fixed the radiator? It's still freezing.

options.A: Radiators in this building are ancient.
options.B: Don't hold your breath on that.
options.C: I signed the lease back in June.

items.explanation: 室友问暖气修没修，屋里还是很冷。正确答 B 用地道口语 "Don't hold your breath"（别抱太大希望）自然承接，暗示维修短期内没指望（idiomatic）。A 抓住 radiator 感慨这楼的暖气片年久失修，只评论设备、不回答修没修（语义联想陷阱）。C 说自己六月就签了租约，与维修进度无关（离题）。D 回答"走廊尽头第二个门"，答的是位置，而对方问的是修没修（答非所问）。
